name: Intellectual property
question: Where are patents, trademarks and licences registered here, and who owns or can hold them?
sources: WIPO Lex or the official IP-office directory, as an official intergovernmental index
fields: costs[]: item, amount, currency, aud, source, checked
rules: Link the official IP office (and WIPO Lex where useful) and note any published rule on foreign ownership, licensing or first-to-file practice that a founder needs.
Country first. IP rights are almost always national.
